summary: A user-supplied local document (idea transcript) cannot be registered as a reference source or linked to the ideas derived from it
expected: A `source register` command (or console form) accepting a local file path or URL, computing a content digest, and linking the source to one or more ideas with a role (inspiration/market_reference/validation), so idea provenance is recorded at intake.
actual: `foundry source register` does not exist (`source` only offers `list`). PortfolioService.record_source has no CLI/HTTP caller and only accepts an http(s) URL with a claim shape. Nine ideas (AS01–AS09) were created from idea_queue/agentic_stack_ideas.md (sha256 df96c6519730d44369aaae096189e51a14b1bf7e7148ed8d5739e2fd8031adb5) with no retained link to that source.
reproduction: From the Foundry repo: `python3 tools/foundry_agent.py cli source register --input any.json` → argparse error 'invalid choice: register'. Inspect src/startup_foundry/console_commands.py source parser and grep callers of record_source.
impact: Provenance of transcript-derived ideas lives only in free-text descriptions; the Sources page and idea pages show 'No linked sources yet' for the whole cohort; later competition evidence cannot cite a stored source ID.
suggestion: Add `source register --input` (kind, title, locator path/URL, publisher, dates, notes, idea_ids, role) with stable digest-based identity and `idea link-source`; show role on the idea page. Being implemented in package F02 (work f2f51679-77a1-4e6a-8468-50dd79cbeca3).
